name: Soushisouai Lolita no Seikatsu
original_name: 相思相愛ロリータの生活
source:
Ever since she came, Life is dyed in vivid color.

A loli utopia of love. From her good morning kiss to her bedtime ecchi.

Let's fill the room with flowers.
Let's take a walk together.
Let's say farewell to all worries.

She falls asleep holding your hand and wakes up to start it all again.

"Was today a good day?"

[Edited From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181679.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
自从她到来，生活便染上鲜明色彩。

这是爱的萝莉乌托邦。从早安之吻，到睡前的色色时光。

让房间开满鲜花。

一起散步吧。

和所有烦恼道别吧。

她牵着你的手入睡，醒来后又开始重复这一切。

“今天过得开心吗？”

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181679.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
